assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one full-frame 16:9 cinematic CG for the Japanese anime game Refrain, no panels. Reference 1 (six-frame Mina story atlas) defines the scene and identities, especially the bottom two panels: three friends have returned to help black-haired Mina after her boss battle. Reference 2 (rooftop group) defines the precise polished anime linework, faces and clothing quality; do NOT use its rooftop location. Reference 3 (silver Mina in glass hall) defines the detailed glass hall environment and Mina's maid outfit. New scene: a quiet close group at eye level inside the tall reflective glass hall, blue-violet damaged panes beginning to admit pale amber light, no action. Four characters ONLY. Left Akari, blonde short low ponytail, violet eyes, cream cardigan white office shirt blue ID lanyard, kneeling slightly and speaking gently. Center-left Koharu, brown shoulder length hair small gold clip, amber eyes, navy school blazer and purple ribbon, attentive. Behind them real-world Rei, short dark navy bob, violet eyes, gray hoodie white shirt, calm not her long-haired VTuber avatar. Right Mina sits exhausted but listening, long BLACK hair, blue eyes, white maid headband, navy-white modest maid dress and rectangular blue brooch. Her black hair and cuff retain a few small ink-like stains from the battle, no gore or exposed body, no thorn monster. Mina is looking at Akari, not camera; friends wait at her eye level instead of looming over her. Their hands rest naturally near Mina, no grabbing, no magical light ball in front, no UI. Express relief through restrained faces and close attention, not exaggerated smiles or tears. Cinematic medium framing: all four complete heads and shoulders within x=8%-92%, y=14%-50%; important hands within y=45%-63%. Bottom 28% is plain natural floor/clothing continuation for in-game subtitle overlay, not a painted text box; top 10% quiet background. Crisp controlled detailed Japanese anime/visual-novel illustration, precisely match reference 2/3, not photorealism, not 3D, not chibi, no lens blur, no text, no logos, no borders, no collage, no watermark.

prompts: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit reference 1, the four friends kneeling in the glass hall, into the NEXT cinematic CG in the same scene. Reference 2 is ONLY Mina's restored SILVER-WHITE hair, clean outfit and gently relieved expression. Preserve reference 1's precise polished Japanese anime drawing style, background glass hall, all four faces, identity, outfits, left-to-right order and camera eye level. Change action and Mina's state: Akari offers one open hand, and Mina herself places her hand lightly into Akari's palm. The two anatomically natural hands make one quiet clear connection at the CENTER, around x=52% y=59% of frame, visible ABOVE the bottom 28% subtitle area. Arrange their arms naturally to reach this high point. Koharu and real-world short-haired Rei stay close watching with small relieved smiles. Mina's long hair is now entirely SILVER-WHITE with soft lavender shadows as reference 2, blue eyes, white maid headband, navy-white modest maid outfit with blue rectangular jewel now clean; all the ink stains have fallen away. Mina has a tiny relieved tear but is not laughing and not a big triumphant smile. No literal magic orb, no flying petals, no particles covering faces, no black hair left. Camera slightly wider than reference 1: keep ALL head tops/headband safely below y=14%, eyes around y=30%-45%. Four people only, heads never touch frame edges. The hand connection is the emotional action; it MUST NOT be low at their laps or hidden by a subtitle. Warm light remains modest so this is before the final sunrise outside. Full opaque 16:9 landscape, no borders, no panels, no text or UI, no watermark. Do not add another hand or person, do not change Rei to long-haired VTuber, do not change Akari's cream cardigan or Koharu's navy blazer and purple ribbon.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact scene. Change ONLY the pose of Akari's extended arm and Mina's extended arm, raising their joined hands to CHEST HEIGHT: the hand contact must be at x=48% y=55% of the image, directly in front of Koharu's upper chest and Rei's lower chest, not at waist or knee level. Their upper arms and elbows bend naturally to support this higher hand connection. This is essential: the bottom 30% will be completely covered by the game's subtitles, so BOTH connected hands and fingers must be entirely above y=63%. Make Akari's palm open and upward, Mina lightly placing her hand on it, anatomy clear, only one hand from each. Keep the other resting hands, all four characters' identities, faces, hair, head positions, outfits, expressions and the entire glass hall background and camera composition unchanged. Mina's hair remains entirely silver-white, blue eyes; Akari blonde cream cardigan; Koharu brown hair school blazer; Rei short navy hair gray hoodie. Do not add people, fingers, text, effects or UI. Full-frame opaque 16:9, same precise anime illustration finish.
